forms.label: 名词（红外线；红外辐射，不可数）

senses.title: The band beyond red
senses.titleCN: 红光之外的那段不可见辐射
senses.definition: the region of the electromagnetic spectrum with wavelengths longer than visible red but shorter than microwaves
senses.definitionCN: 电磁波谱中波长比可见红光更长、比微波更短的那一段
senses.example: A thermal camera reads the infrared that a warm body emits in a dark room.
senses.exampleCN: 暗室中，热成像仪读取温暖人体发出的红外线。
senses.why: infra- means below, so the name places this band below red on the ordered scale of colours.
senses.whyCN: infra- 意为「在下方」，因此这个名字把这一段放在颜色次序中红的下面。

senses.title: Infrared radiation as heat
senses.definition: the invisible radiation that warm objects emit and that is felt as radiant heat
senses.definitionCN: 温热物体发出、可被感受为辐射热的不可见辐射
senses.example: The fire warms the room mostly through infrared radiation.
senses.exampleCN: 炉火主要靠红外辐射把房间烘暖。
senses.why: every object at ordinary temperature peaks in this band, so this is the radiation people actually feel as warmth.
senses.whyCN: 普通温度下的物体大多在这一波段辐射最强，因此人们实际感到的暖意正是这种辐射。

senses.title: Thermal imaging
senses.titleCN: 热成像：把红外转成可见图像
senses.definition: the use of infrared detectors to build a picture of temperature differences, as in night vision or fault finding
senses.definitionCN: 用红外探测器把温差转成图像，如夜视或故障排查
senses.example: Infrared imaging showed where the wall was losing heat.
senses.exampleCN: 红外成像显示出墙体在哪里散失热量。
senses.why: a detector can translate an invisible band into a visible picture, so the word comes to name the technique.
senses.whyCN: 探测器能把不可见波段转成可见图像，于是这个词也指这项技术。

senses.title: Remote control signals
senses.definition: the pulsed infrared light that a hand-held control sends to a receiver a few metres away
senses.definitionCN: 手持遥控器向几米外接收器发送的脉冲红外光
senses.example: Infrared remote control works only when nothing blocks the beam.
senses.exampleCN: 红外遥控只有光束不被挡住时才有效。
senses.why: the band is invisible and cheap to generate, which makes it ideal for short line-of-sight commands.
senses.whyCN: 这一段不可见且易于产生，因此很适合作短距离、需直视的指令传输。

senses.title: Infrared astronomy
senses.titleCN: 红外天文学：观测冷天体与尘埃
senses.definition: the observation of celestial objects through their infrared emission, which penetrates dust that hides visible light
senses.definitionCN: 借天体红外辐射进行观测，可穿透遮挡可见光的尘埃
senses.example: Infrared astronomy revealed stars still forming inside dark clouds.
senses.exampleCN: 红外天文学揭示出仍在暗云中形成的恒星。
senses.why: cool objects and dust-shrouded regions glow mainly in this band, so astronomy needs it to see what visible light cannot.
senses.whyCN: 冷天体与被尘埃包裹的区域主要在这一波段发光，因此天文学需要它来看到可见光看不到的东西。

senses.title: Infrared spectroscopy
senses.titleCN: 红外光谱法：读分子振动
senses.definition: the use of infrared absorption bands to identify chemical bonds and molecular structure
senses.definitionCN: 利用红外吸收带识别化学键与分子结构
senses.example: Infrared spectroscopy identifies the functional groups in a sample.
senses.exampleCN: 红外光谱法能识别样品中的官能团。
senses.why: infrared photons have just the energies that stretch and bend bonds, so this band reads structure.
senses.whyCN: 红外光子的能量正好能让化学键伸缩与弯曲，因此这一段读的是结构。

senses.title: Near and far subdivisions
senses.titleCN: 近红外与远红外的分区
senses.definition: the division of the band into near infrared, closest to visible light, and far infrared, closest to microwaves
senses.definitionCN: 把该波段分为靠近可见光的近红外与靠近微波的远红外
senses.example: Near infrared penetrates fog better than visible light does.
senses.exampleCN: 近红外穿透雾的能力强于可见光。
senses.why: a broad band needed subdivisions, and they are named by distance from the visible edge.
senses.whyCN: 一段宽波段需要再分，分区便按离可见光边缘的远近命名。

senses.title: Infrared heating
senses.titleCN: 红外加热：直接辐射受热体
senses.definition: heating by directing infrared radiation at an object so that its surface warms without heating the air first
senses.definitionCN: 把红外辐射直接投向物体，使表面升温而不必先加热空气
senses.example: An infrared heater warms the terrace without warming the air around it.
senses.exampleCN: 红外取暖器把露台烘暖，却不加热周围空气。
senses.why: radiant heat can be aimed like light, so the adjective names a whole method of warming.
senses.whyCN: 辐射热可以像光一样瞄准，因此这个形容词命名了一整套加热方式。

intro.en: Infrared is a Latin-English hybrid: infra, below, plus the English colour word red. It was coined in the 1870s, after invisible radiation beyond red was measured.
intro.cn: infrared 是拉丁与英语的混合词：拉丁 infra「在下方」加英语颜色词 red。它于 1870 年代、在红光之外不可见辐射被测量之后出现。

items.en: Infra meant below or beneath, and English uses it as the prefix infra-, as in infrastructure and infrasonic.
items.cn: infra 意为「在下方、在下」，英语以 infra- 作前缀，如 infrastructure 与 infrasonic。

items.en: Red is a native English colour word from Old English read; it is cognate with Latin ruber but not borrowed from it.
items.cn: red 是古英语 read 而来的本族颜色词；它与拉丁 ruber 同源，但并非借自拉丁。

items.en: Herschel placed a thermometer beyond the red end of a prism spectrum and found it warmed, proving radiation beyond visible red.
items.cn: 赫歇尔把温度计放在棱镜光谱红端之外，发现那里变热，从而证明红光之外还有辐射。

items.en: The English term infrared was formed in the 1870s, once the measurement needed a name; earlier writers used ultra-red.
items.cn: 英语 infrared 于 1870 年代成形，因为测量结果需要一个名字；更早的作者用过 ultra-red。

items.en: Thermal imaging, remote controls and infrared spectroscopy all date from the twentieth century and widened the word.
items.cn: 热成像、遥控与红外光谱法都出现在 20 世纪，扩展了这个词的使用范围。

items.en: Source uncertain (first date only): the exact first use of infrared is not agreed and ultra-red competed with it; infra itself is an established Latin preposition, so no root uncertainty attaches to that half.
items.cn: 来源不确定（仅首见年代）：infrared 的确切首用无定论，且曾与 ultra-red 并存；infra 本身是有据的拉丁介词，因此这一半不存在词根存疑。

note.en: Group one holds words that mark where a band sits relative to a boundary; group two holds the neighbouring bands and the common names for their effects.
note.cn: 第一组是标出某波段相对边界位置的词；第二组是相邻波段及其效应的通称。

entries.definition: Ultra- means beyond, so ultraviolet sits past the violet end, with shorter waves and higher energy.
entries.definitionCN: ultra- 意为「超出」，因此紫外线在紫端之外，波长更短、能量更高。

entries.definition: Infra- plus sound: waves too low in pitch for the ear, a different scale entirely.
entries.definitionCN: infra- 加「声」：音高低于人耳可闻的波，完全属于另一套尺度。

entries.definition: Ultra- plus sound: waves too high in pitch for the ear, used in sonar and cleaning baths.
entries.definitionCN: ultra- 加「声」：音高高于人耳可闻的波，用于声呐与清洗槽。

entries.definition: An older rival of infrared, built with ultra- instead of infra; it lost and is now rare.
entries.definitionCN: infrared 的旧日竞争写法，用 ultra- 而非 infra-；后来落败，现已罕用。

entries.definition: The radiation any warm body emits; most of it falls in the infrared band.
entries.definitionCN: 任何温热物体发出的辐射，大部分落在红外波段。

entries.definition: The energy transferred by temperature difference; infrared is one of the ways it travels.
entries.definitionCN: 由温差传递的能量；红外是它传递的方式之一。

entries.definition: The band just beyond far infrared, with longer waves used for radar and ovens.
entries.definitionCN: 远红外之外的那一段，波长更长，用于雷达与微波炉。

entries.definition: The band the eye can see, lying just beyond near infrared on the other side of red.
entries.definitionCN: 肉眼能看见的那一段，在红端另一侧、紧邻近红外。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the real Latin prefix, the real experiment and the real applications.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：真实的拉丁前缀、真实的实验与真实的应用。

normal.en: infra- means below, so infrared is the band below red on the colour scale.
normal.cn: infra- 意为「在下方」，因此红外是颜色次序中红之下的那一段。

normal.en: Herschel 1800 found warmth beyond red with a thermometer.
normal.cn: 1800 年赫歇尔用温度计在红光之外测到了热。

normal.en: Every warm object emits it, so the band is the heat you cannot see.
normal.cn: 每个温热物体都发出它，因此这一段就是看不见的热。

normal.en: The subdivisions are near infrared and far infrared.
normal.cn: 分区是近红外与远红外。

normal.en: The adjective and the noun are spelled the same: infrared light, the infrared.
normal.cn: 形容词与名词拼写相同：红外光、红外波段。

abstract.en: Picture a colour just past the last colour, where only warmth remains.
abstract.cn: 想象一种颜色，刚过最后一种颜色，那里只剩下暖意。

abstract.en: Picture a dark room where people glow without any lamp.
abstract.cn: 想象一间黑屋，人不用灯也在发着光。

abstract.en: Picture a beam that carries a command instead of a picture.
abstract.cn: 想象一束光，送的是命令而不是图像。

examples.en: The satellite maps forest fires by their infrared glow.
examples.cn: 这颗卫星根据森林火灾发出的红外辉光绘制火点。

examples.en: Most remote controls send a coded infrared pulse.
examples.cn: 大多数遥控器发送编码的红外脉冲。

examples.en: Infrared heaters warm people directly rather than warming the air.
examples.cn: 红外取暖器直接把人烘暖，而不是加热空气。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「infra（在下方）+ red（红）」——排在红色之下的那一段 → 红外线

root: 拉丁 infra「在下方」+ 英语 red（古英语 read）；red 与拉丁 ruber 同源但非借自拉丁，infra 为有据的拉丁介词。英语 infrared。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses start at the band itself, then move to felt heat, imaging, remote commands, astronomy, spectroscopy, the near-far split and radiant heating.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项从波段本身开始，随后走向可感的热、成像、遥控、天文、光谱、近远分区与辐射加热。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a body in a dark room showing as an orange shape on a screen.
core.cn: 核心意象：黑屋中的人体在屏幕上显出一团橙红的形状。

branches.en: POSITION: the prefix fixes the band just below red, and every later sense inherits that address.
branches.cn: 位置：前缀把这一段定在红之下，后来每个义项都继承这个地址。

branches.en: WARMTH: the band is both what a body emits and what a heater aims.
branches.cn: 暖意：这一段既是物体发出的，也是取暖器所瞄准的。

branches.en: SIGNALS: an invisible band becomes a picture or a command.
branches.cn: 信号：不可见的一段变成了图像或命令。

branches.en: KNOWLEDGE: dust-hidden stars and vibrating bonds are both read in this band.
branches.cn: 认知：藏在尘埃中的恒星与振动的化学键，都在这一段被读取。

branches.en: SUBDIVISION: near and far keep the band ordered by distance from visible light.
branches.cn: 再分：近与远按离可见光的距离把这一段继续排序。

intro.en: Infrared is a Latin prefix on a native English colour word, a small but very productive pattern in scientific naming.
intro.cn: infrared 是拉丁前缀加英语本族颜色词，这在科学命名中是一种小而多产的构词方式。

latinIntro.en: Infra is a genuine Latin preposition; red is native English. No Latin noun stands behind the whole word, so the Latin entries cover only the prefix side.
latinIntro.cn: infra 是有据的拉丁介词，red 是英语本族词。整词背后没有拉丁名词，因此拉丁条目只覆盖前缀这一侧。

items.example: The prefix places the band below red.
items.exampleCN: 这个前缀把该波段放在红之下。

items.structure: red (native English adjective, Old English read)
items.example: The last visible band is red.
items.exampleCN: 最后一个可见波段是红色。

items.example: The camera reads infrared.
items.exampleCN: 相机读取红外线。

items.meaning: the part closest to visible red
items.meaningCN: 最靠近可见红光的那部分
items.example: Near-infrared light passes through fog.
items.exampleCN: 近红外光能穿过雾。

items.example: Far-infrared panels heat a room slowly.
items.exampleCN: 远红外板缓慢地把房间加热。

items.example: The infrared camera found the leak.
items.exampleCN: 红外相机找到了漏点。

items.example: The infrared sensor opened the door.
items.exampleCN: 红外传感器把门打开了。

items.example: Infrared spectroscopy found the bond.
items.exampleCN: 红外光谱法找到了那个化学键。

items.meaningCN: 在红外波段进行的天文观测
items.example: Infrared astronomy sees into dust clouds.
items.exampleCN: 红外天文学能看进尘埃云内部。

latinEntries.structure: inferus, infera, inferum (adj., first and second declension)

definition_zh: 气旋；热带风暴；低压环流；旋风分离器
definition_en: a weather system in which winds rotate inward around a low-pressure centre
core_image: 一大团云系绕着中心低压逆时针收紧，风从四面灌入、再被甩向外围
scene: 气象台的屏幕上，一团云系逆时针向内旋紧，值班员指着它说 A cyclone is tightening its grip on the coast tonight.
sceneCN: 这里 cyclone 指「热带风暴系统」（第 1 个义项：暖海面上生成、风绕低压中心旋转的强风暴）；句意为今晚一个气旋正在收紧对海岸的掌控。

pos.zh: 气旋；热带风暴；低压环流系统

senses.title: Tropical storm with rotating winds
senses.titleCN: 热带气旋：风绕低压中心旋转的强风暴
senses.definition: a violent tropical storm in which strong winds rotate around a centre of low pressure
senses.definitionCN: 强风围绕低压中心旋转的猛烈热带风暴
senses.example: The cyclone tore roofs off houses along the delta.
senses.exampleCN: 气旋把三角洲一带房屋的屋顶掀掉了。
senses.why: The Greek root means a wheel or a coil, so the storm is named for the circular path its winds trace.
senses.whyCN: 希腊词根意为轮子或盘绕之物，因此这场风暴是按风的圆形路径命名的。

senses.title: The official name in the Indian Ocean
senses.titleCN: 印度洋与南太平洋的官方称名
senses.definition: the official term used in the Indian Ocean and South Pacific for a tropical storm of hurricane strength
senses.definitionCN: 印度洋与南太平洋对达到飓风强度的热带风暴所用的正式称名
senses.example: Cyclone Fani forced the evacuation of millions in Odisha.
senses.exampleCN: 气旋「法尼」迫使奥迪沙邦数百万人撤离。
senses.why: Storm basins name the same phenomenon differently: hurricane in the Atlantic, typhoon in the Pacific, cyclone in the Indian Ocean.
senses.whyCN: 各风暴海域对同一现象有不同叫法：大西洋叫 hurricane，太平洋叫 typhoon，印度洋叫 cyclone。

senses.title: Extratropical low-pressure system
senses.titleCN: 温带气旋：中纬度的低压系统
senses.definition: a large low-pressure system outside the tropics whose fronts bring gales and heavy rain
senses.definitionCN: 热带以外的大型低压系统，其锋面带来大风与大雨
senses.example: An extratropical cyclone brought two days of rain to the region.
senses.exampleCN: 一个温带气旋给该地区带来了两天降雨。
senses.why: The rotating structure is the defining feature, so the word extends beyond the tropics to any organised low.
senses.whyCN: 旋转结构才是定义特征，因此这个词从热带扩展到任何有组织的低压系统。

senses.title: Cyclonic circulation
senses.titleCN: 气旋式环流：向内旋入的风场
senses.definition: the inward-spiralling wind pattern around a low-pressure centre, counter-clockwise in the northern hemisphere
senses.definitionCN: 围绕低压中心向内旋入的风场，在北半球呈逆时针方向
senses.example: Satellite images showed a tight cyclonic circulation near the islands.
senses.exampleCN: 卫星图像显示岛屿附近有一个紧密的气旋式环流。
senses.why: Here the word names the motion rather than the storm, and the same geometry appears at every scale of low pressure.
senses.whyCN: 这里指的不是风暴本身而是运动形态，同一几何形状出现在各种尺度的低压系统里。

senses.title: The storm as a destructive event
senses.definition: the storm viewed as an event that strikes a coast with wind, rain and storm surge
senses.definitionCN: 从侵袭海岸、带来狂风、暴雨与风暴潮的事件角度看的风暴
senses.example: The cyclone left the harbour closed for a week.
senses.exampleCN: 这场气旋让港口关闭了一周。
senses.why: News reports talk about the event rather than the physics, so the word comes to mean the disaster itself.
senses.whyCN: 新闻报道谈的是事件而非物理机制，因此这个词转而指灾害本身。

senses.title: A low-pressure area on a weather chart
senses.definition: a low-pressure area marked on a synoptic chart, with closed isobars around its centre
senses.definitionCN: 天气图上以闭合等压线围出中心的低压区
senses.example: The chart shows a cyclone deepening over the bay.
senses.exampleCN: 天气图显示一个气旋正在海湾上空加深。
senses.why: Meteorologists label the pressure pattern, not just the storm, and the same word covers both.
senses.whyCN: 气象学家标注的是气压形势而不只是风暴，同一个词覆盖两者。

senses.title: Figurative whirl of events
senses.titleCN: 比喻义：事件或情绪的漩涡
senses.definition: a rapidly swirling mass of events, emotions or activity that draws people in
senses.definitionCN: 迅速旋转、把人卷进去的事件、情绪或活动
senses.example: A cyclone of rumours swept through the newsroom.
senses.exampleCN: 一场谣言的漩涡席卷了新闻编辑室。
senses.why: The metaphor keeps the shape of the weather: everything is pulled inward and spun faster and faster.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻保留了天气的形状：一切被吸向中心，越转越快。

senses.title: Industrial cyclone separator
senses.definition: a cone-shaped device that spins dusty air so particles fall out and clean air rises
senses.definitionCN: 让含尘空气旋转、使颗粒落下而洁净空气上升的锥形装置
senses.example: The sawmill uses a cyclone to collect sawdust from the air.
senses.exampleCN: 锯木厂用旋风分离器从空气中收集锯屑。
senses.why: Engineers copied the storm's geometry: a spinning vortex throws heavy particles outward and downward.
senses.whyCN: 工程师照搬了风暴的几何：旋转涡流把较重颗粒甩向外侧和下方。

intro.en: Cyclone was coined in the nineteenth century from Greek kyklos 'circle, wheel' and its derivative kykloma 'that which rolls'. The root is Greek, and Latin borrowed the same word as cyclus.
intro.cn: cyclone 于 19 世纪由希腊语 kyklos「圆、轮」及其派生词 kyklōma「滚动之物」造出。词根属希腊语，拉丁语也借入了同一个词作 cyclus。

items.en: Kyklos meant 'circle, wheel' and appears in kyklos trokhos 'wheel'; it is the source of English cycle and cyclical.
items.cn: kyklos 意为「圆、轮」，见于 kyklos trokhos「车轮」；它是英语 cycle、cyclical 的来源。

items.en: Kykloma, from kykloun 'to move in a circle', named a wheel or a coiled object, and supplied the shape of the second half of the word.
items.cn: kyklōma 出自 kykloun「作圆周运动」，指轮子或盘绕之物，提供了这个词后半部分的形态。

items.en: Latin borrowed the Greek noun as cyclus 'circle, cycle', with the adjective cyclicus; the Latin form kept the k-sound written as c.
items.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊名词作 cyclus「圆、循环」，形容词为 cyclicus；拉丁拼写用 c 记这个 k 音。

items.en: In 1848 a British meteorologist proposed cyclone for the circular storms of the Indian Ocean, forming it on the Greek noun for a whirling thing.
items.cn: 1848 年一位英国气象学者提议用 cyclone 命名印度洋的圆形风暴，依据的是希腊语中表示旋转之物的名词。

items.en: The word spread to all tropical basins and then to any low-pressure system with closed circulation; the industrial sense came later by analogy.
items.cn: 这个词随后扩展到所有热带海域，再扩展到任何具有闭合环流的低压系统；工业义则更晚由类比产生。

note.en: The first group contains words that look or sound close to cyclone; the second contains the other names for rotating storms and their opposite.
note.cn: 第一组是形音相近的词；第二组是旋转风暴的其他名称及其对立面。

entries.definition: From Greek kyklos 'circle, wheel' through Latin cyclus: a recurring round of events, or a bicycle. It shares the root but not the storm meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 经拉丁语 cyclus 来自希腊 kyklos「圆、轮」：循环的一轮，或自行车。同根但无风暴义。

entries.definition: A person who rides a cycle; the ending -ist marks a person, so it cannot name a weather system.
entries.definitionCN: 骑自行车的人；后缀 -ist 表人，因此不能指天气系统。

entries.definition: From Greek kylindros 'roller', a different root from kyklos; it names a solid with circular ends.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊 kylindros「滚子」，与 kyklos 不同根；指两端为圆的立体。

entries.definition: From Greek kynikos 'dog-like', the root of Cynic philosophy; it has nothing to do with circles or storms.
entries.definitionCN: 来自希腊 kynikos「像狗的」，是犬儒学派词根；与圆或风暴无关。

entries.definition: The Atlantic and eastern Pacific name for a tropical cyclone with sustained winds of at least 119 km/h.
entries.definitionCN: 大西洋与东太平洋对持续风速至少每小时 119 公里的热带气旋的称名。

entries.definition: The western Pacific name for the same kind of storm; only the basin, not the physics, differs.
entries.definitionCN: 西太平洋对同一类风暴的称名；差别只在海域而不在物理机制。

entries.definition: A much smaller, violently rotating column of air reaching the ground from a thundercloud.
entries.definitionCN: 小得多、从雷暴云伸到地面的猛烈旋转空气柱。

entries.definition: A high-pressure system with outward-spiralling winds; it is the mirror image, not a synonym.
entries.definitionCN: 风向外旋出的高压系统；是镜像对立面而非同义词。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations: the Greek root, real meteorological compounds and the real derived family, not invented rhymes.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想：希腊词根、真实气象复合词与真实派生词族，而非编造的顺口溜。

normal.en: kyklos 'circle' is the whole word: a storm that runs in circles.
normal.cn: kyklos「圆」就是全部要义：绕圈跑的风暴。

normal.en: The same root sits in cycle, bicycle and cyclical.
normal.cn: 同一词根在 cycle、bicycle、cyclical 里。

normal.en: Basin names sit in a row: hurricane, typhoon, cyclone.
normal.cn: 三个海域的名称并排记：hurricane、typhoon、cyclone。

normal.en: The adjective is cyclonic, as in cyclonic circulation.
normal.cn: 形容词是 cyclonic，如气旋式环流。

normal.en: Cyclogenesis is birth, cyclolysis is death, of a cyclone.
normal.cn: cyclogenesis 是气旋的生成，cyclolysis 是气旋的消散。

abstract.en: Picture water draining from a basin, faster and faster toward the hole.
abstract.cn: 想象水从盆里排出，越靠近洞口转得越快。

abstract.en: Picture a rumour spinning through an office and pulling everyone inward.
abstract.cn: 想象一则谣言在办公室里打转，把每个人往里卷。

abstract.en: Picture dust in a cone, thrown to the wall while clean air climbs the middle.
abstract.cn: 想象锥体里的粉尘被甩到壁上，干净空气从中间上升。

examples.en: The cyclone destroyed the coastal road and cut off three villages.
examples.cn: 气旋毁掉了沿海公路，切断了三个村庄的交通。

examples.en: Forecasters track a cyclone by its closed isobars and cloud spiral.
examples.cn: 预报员靠闭合等压线和云系螺旋追踪气旋。

examples.en: A cyclone separator removes most of the dust before the air reaches the filter.
examples.cn: 旋风分离器在空气进入过滤器之前除去大部分粉尘。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「赛克隆」——云团赛跑一样克隆出一圈圈旋转的风

root: 希腊 kyklos「圆、轮」→ kyklōma「滚动之物」；1848 年由气象学者据此造词命名印度洋的圆形风暴。词根清楚，命名年代有明确记载；与拉丁 cyclus 同源。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one shape: air spiralling around a low, from a tropical storm and its regional name, through temperate lows, circulation, disaster and chart symbol, to a metaphor and a machine.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿一个形状展开：空气绕低压旋转——从热带风暴及其地域称名，经温带低压、环流、灾害与天气图符号，到比喻义与机器。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a spiral of cloud winding inward around a low-pressure eye.
core.cn: 核心意象：云带绕低压眼向内盘绕的螺旋。

branches.en: TROPICAL AND NAMED: the same storm is a cyclone everywhere, but only Indian Ocean forecasts use that name officially.
branches.cn: 热带与命名：同一场风暴在各处都是气旋，但只有印度洋的预报正式使用这个名称。

branches.en: COLD AND CHARTED: outside the tropics the same low appears as a pressure pattern on the map.
branches.cn: 温带与图面：热带之外同一个低压以图上的气压形势出现。

branches.en: MOTION AND IMPACT: the inward spiral is the mechanism, the landfall is the event people remember.
branches.cn: 运动与影响：向内螺旋是机制，登陆是人们记住的事件。

branches.en: SOCIAL WHIRL: events and feelings can spin inward the way air does.
branches.cn: 社会漩涡：事件与情绪可以像空气那样向内旋转。

branches.en: MACHINE COPY: industry builds the same vortex in a cone to sort dust from air.
branches.cn: 机器复制：工业在锥体里造出同样的涡流，把粉尘与空气分开。

intro.en: Cyclone is Greek root plus a Greek-derived ending, with no native English suffix. Its family grows through -ic, -ically, anti- and the combining forms cyclo- and -genesis.
intro.cn: cyclone 是希腊词根加希腊来源的词尾，没有本土英语后缀。它的词族靠 -ic、-ically、anti- 以及组合成分 cyclo-、-genesis 扩展。

latinIntro.en: Latin borrowed the Greek noun as cyclus and formed the adjective cyclicus; those forms are the bridge by which the root reached English spelling.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语借入这个希腊名词作 cyclus，并构成形容词 cyclicus；这些形式是词根进入英语拼写的桥梁。

items.example: Cyclo- appears in cyclorama and cyclotron.
items.exampleCN: cyclo- 出现在 cyclorama（环形画景）与 cyclotron（回旋加速器）中。

items.example: The root underlies cycle and encyclopedia.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根是 cycle 与 encyclopedia 的基础。

items.structure: -one (terminal element borrowed with the Greek noun, not a productive suffix)
items.meaning: the ending carried over from Greek kykloma
items.meaningCN: 随希腊名词借入的词尾，并非能产后缀
items.example: The ending appears in cyclone but builds no new English words.
items.exampleCN: 这个词尾只出现在 cyclone 里，不能构成新的英语词。

items.meaning: relating to a cyclone or to rotating winds
items.example: Cyclonic winds closed the ferry service.
items.exampleCN: 气旋性大风使渡轮停航。

items.example: The air turned cyclonically around the centre.
items.exampleCN: 空气绕中心作气旋式旋转。

items.meaning: a high-pressure system with outward winds
items.example: The anticyclone kept the sky clear for a week.
items.exampleCN: 反气旋让天空连续一周晴朗。

items.meaning: the formation and strengthening of a cyclone
items.example: Cyclogenesis began over the warm shelf water.
items.exampleCN: 气旋生成在温暖的陆架海面上开始。

items.meaning: the weakening and decay of a cyclone
items.example: Cyclolysis followed quickly after landfall.
items.exampleCN: 登陆之后气旋迅速消散。

latinEntries.structure: cyclus, cycli (m., second declension; borrowed from Greek kyklos)
cyclicus, cyclica, cyclicum (adjective; from Greek kyklikos)

definition_zh: 定性的；性质上的；质的；描述性的；非量化的；品质层面的；（化学）定性分析的
definition_en: relating to qualities or to the kind of thing something is, rather than to how much of it there is
core_image: 不去数篮子里有几个苹果，而是拿起每一个看颜色、尝味道、摸质地——只问「什么样」，不问「多少」
scene: 这里指「定性的」。 A researcher closes the spreadsheet and says: The interviews are qualitative data, so we describe themes instead of counting answers.
sceneCN: 这里 qualitative 是「描述性的、非量化的」（第 4 个义项：用文字描述而不计量）；句意：访谈属于定性数据，所以我们描述主题，而不是统计答案。画面里有录音笔、被高亮的文本和合上的表格。

pos.zh: 定性的；性质（上）的；质的；描述性的

senses.title: Qualitative research: study by description
senses.titleCN: 定性研究：靠描述做学问
senses.definition: using observation, interviews, or written accounts rather than measurement to study something
senses.definitionCN: 用观察、访谈或文字记述来研究，而不是用测量
senses.example: The team ran a qualitative study of how nurses talk to patients.
senses.exampleCN: 团队开展了一项定性研究，考察护士如何与病人交谈。
senses.why: The word was coined in early 15c. as 'that produces a quality'; only around 1600 did it mean 'concerned with quality without reference to quantity'. Research methods took that second sense and made it a name for work that records kinds and meanings instead of numbers.
senses.whyCN: 这个词在 15 世纪初造出时意为「产生某种性质的」；直到约 1600 年才表示「只关性质、不涉数量」。研究方法取了这个义项，用它命名记录种类与意义、而非数字的工作。

senses.title: Of a quality: belonging to what something is
senses.titleCN: 性质上的：属于「它是什么」的那一面
senses.definition: relating to a quality or qualities that something possesses
senses.definitionCN: 关于某物所具有的性质或属性的
senses.example: Heat and cold are qualitative states of the air, not amounts of it.
senses.exampleCN: 冷与热是空气的性质状态，而不是空气的量。
senses.why: Medieval Latin qualitativus meant 'relating to quality', built on qualitas. The adjective simply points at the property itself: not how much, but what sort.
senses.whyCN: 中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus 意为「关于性质的」，由 qualitas 构成。这个形容词只是指向性质本身：不是多少，而是何种。

senses.title: Qualitative difference: a difference in kind
senses.titleCN: 质的差别：种类上的不同
senses.definition: describing a difference in kind, character, or nature rather than in degree or amount
senses.definitionCN: 指种类、性质或本性上的差别，而非程度或数量上的
senses.example: There is a qualitative difference between being tired and being ill.
senses.exampleCN: 「累」和「病」之间有质的差别。
senses.why: Once the adjective means 'concerned with quality alone', two things can differ in quality rather than quantity. This is the sense that lets English oppose qualitative to quantitative as two kinds of difference.
senses.whyCN: 一旦这个形容词表示「只关乎性质」，两样东西就可以在性质上而非数量上不同。正是这个义项让英语把 qualitative 与 quantitative 对立成两种差别。

senses.title: Qualitative data: words, not figures
senses.titleCN: 定性数据：是文字，不是数字
senses.definition: consisting of descriptions, words, images, or observations rather than numerical measurements
senses.definitionCN: 由描述、文字、图像或观察构成，而不是数值测量
senses.example: The report mixes qualitative field notes with a few simple counts.
senses.exampleCN: 这份报告把定性的田野笔记与少量简单计数混在一起。
senses.why: Data can be sorted by what it is: numbers measure amount, words record kind. The adjective's 'without reference to quantity' sense gives the label for the second pile.
senses.whyCN: 数据可以按「是什么」分类：数字测量数量，文字记录种类。这个形容词「不涉数量」的义项正好为第二堆数据提供了名称。

senses.title: Quality-level: better in kind, not bigger
senses.titleCN: 品质层面：好在质地，而非更大
senses.definition: relating to the standard or excellence of something rather than its size or amount
senses.definitionCN: 关于某物的水准或优良程度，而非大小或数量
senses.example: The reform brought a qualitative improvement in care, not more beds.
senses.exampleCN: 这项改革带来的是护理品质的提升，而不是更多床位。
senses.why: From 'relating to quality' comes the evaluative use: a qualitative gain is a gain in how good something is. English keeps quality for both 'property' and 'excellence', and the adjective follows both.
senses.whyCN: 从「关于性质」引申出评价用法：qualitative 的提升就是「好在哪」的提升。英语的 quality 兼指「属性」与「优良」，这个形容词两条都跟着走。

senses.title: Qualitative analysis: find out what is there
senses.titleCN: 定性分析：先查明「有什么」
senses.definition: in chemistry, identifying the substances present in a sample without measuring how much of each there is
senses.definitionCN: 化学中鉴定样品里存在哪些物质，而不测定各有多少
senses.example: Qualitative analysis showed the powder contained lead.
senses.exampleCN: 定性分析显示这种粉末含铅。
senses.why: Chemistry splits the question in two: what is it, and how much. The first question asks for kind, so it takes the adjective of quality; quantitative takes the question of amount.
senses.whyCN: 化学把问题一分为二：这是什么，有多少。第一个问的是种类，于是用「性质」的形容词；第二个问数量，才用 quantitative。

senses.title: Qualitative change: a leap into another state
senses.definition: in philosophy, a change in the essential nature of something, as opposed to a change only in amount
senses.definitionCN: 哲学上指事物根本本性的变化，与仅数量上的变化相对
senses.example: The textbook describes water turning to steam as a qualitative change.
senses.exampleCN: 这本教材把水变成蒸汽描述为一种质变。
senses.why: Aristotelian philosophy used qualitas for one of its categories; English inherited that seriousness. If a thing changes in kind and not merely in degree, the change is qualitative — a new state, not a larger old one.
senses.whyCN: 亚里士多德哲学把 qualitas 当作范畴之一，英语继承了这份严肃。当事物在种类上而非仅在程度上改变，这变化就是 qualitative 的——是新状态，而不是旧状态的加量。

senses.title: Qualitative judgement: the feel of a thing
senses.titleCN: 定性判断：凭手感下的结论
senses.definition: based on impressions, experience, or observed character rather than on exact measurement
senses.definitionCN: 基于印象、经验或观察到的特性，而非精确测量
senses.example: The chef made a qualitative judgement about the sauce by tasting it.
senses.exampleCN: 厨师尝了一口，对酱汁作出了定性判断。
senses.why: Where numbers are unavailable, judgement still works by noticing qualities: colour, texture, tone. The adjective names that kind of knowing — real but not countable.
senses.whyCN: 没有数字可用时，判断仍可靠察觉性质来运作：颜色、质地、味道。这个形容词命名的就是这种「真实但数不清」的认识方式。

senses.title: A qualitative adjective: naming a quality
senses.titleCN: 性质形容词：直接命名一种性质
senses.definition: in grammar, an adjective that describes a quality of a noun, such as wooden, kind, or heavy
senses.definitionCN: 语法上指描述名词性质的形容词，如 wooden、kind、heavy
senses.example: Wooden is a qualitative adjective, while this in this table is not.
senses.exampleCN: wooden 是性质形容词，而 this table 里的 this 不是。
senses.why: Grammarians needed a word for adjectives that assign a quality rather than point, count, or relate. They borrowed the adjective of quality itself: a qualitative adjective is one that says what kind.
senses.whyCN: 语法学家需要一个词来指「赋予性质」而非指认、计数或关联的形容词，于是借用了「性质」这个形容词本身：qualitative adjective 就是说明「何种」的那类形容词。

intro.en: Qualitative descends from the Latin question qualis, 'of what kind?' Cicero coined qualitas to render Greek poiotēs, and Medieval Latin added the adjective. English first used it for 'producing a quality' and only around 1600 for 'concerned with quality, not quantity'.
intro.cn: qualitative 源自拉丁语的提问词 qualis「何种？」。西塞罗造出 qualitas 来翻译希腊语 poiotēs，中世纪拉丁语又加上形容词形式。英语先用它表「产生某种性质的」，到约 1600 年才表「只关性质、不涉数量」。

items.en: Qualis was the correlative question word 'of what kind? what sort of?'. Its deeper PIE root *kwo-, the stem of relative and interrogative pronouns, is a reconstruction with no written record, so that layer is marked source uncertain.
items.cn: Qualis 是关联疑问词「何种的？哪一类的？」。它更深的印欧语词根 *kwo-（关系代词与疑问代词词干）是重构形式，没有书面记录，因此那一层标为「来源不确定」。

items.en: Qualitas 'a quality, property; nature, state, condition' is said to have been coined by Cicero to translate Greek poiotēs. The word therefore begins as a philosopher's loan-translation, not a folk term.
items.cn: Qualitas「性质、属性；本性、状态、状况」据说由西塞罗造出，用来翻译希腊语 poiotēs。因此这个词一开始就是哲学家的仿译词，而非民间口语。

items.en: Qualitativus 'relating to quality' supplied the adjective. The suffix -ivus marks 'belonging to or having the nature of', the same ending that gives English -ive.
items.cn: Qualitativus「关于性质的」提供了形容词形式。后缀 -ivus 表示「属于……或有……性质的」，正是英语 -ive 的来源。

items.en: English first records qualitative as qualitatif in the early 15c., meaning 'that produces a (physical) quality'. The word described causes, not methods: a quality-producing agent.
items.cn: 英语最早记录为 15 世纪初的 qualitatif，意为「产生（物理）性质的」。这个词当时描述的是原因而非方法：一个产生性质的动因。

items.en: The modern sense 'concerned with quality, relating to the possession of qualities without reference to quantities' appears about 1600, from French qualitatif or Medieval Latin qualitativus. Quantity drops out, and kind stands alone.
items.cn: 现代义「关于性质的、只涉及是否具有性质而不涉数量」约在 1600 年出现，来自法语 qualitatif 或中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus。数量退场，只剩下种类。

items.en: The adjective became the standard partner and opposite of quantitative in research writing. This pairing is a modern intellectual arrangement, not a separate etymology: the same Latin word simply had its 'not quantity' sense put to work.
items.cn: 这个形容词在现代研究写作中成为 quantitative 的标准搭档与对立面。这种配对是近代的思想安排，而非另一套词源：同一个拉丁词只是让它的「非数量」义发挥了作用。

note.en: The first group is chosen for spelling and sound, the second for meaning, so that form and sense stay separate.
note.cn: 第一组按拼写和读音挑选，第二组按词义挑选，这样词形和词义不会混在一起。

entries.definition: relating to quantity or amount. It differs from qualitative by two letters and by the whole question it asks.
entries.definitionCN: 关于数量或数额的。它与 qualitative 只差几个字母，但问的是完全不同的问题。

entries.definition: the property or standard of something. Qualitative is the adjective built on it.
entries.definitionCN: 性质；质量。qualitative 正是由它构成的形容词。

entries.definition: having the necessary training or a stated limitation. It belongs to qualify, not to quality.
entries.definitionCN: 有资格的；有限定的。它属于 qualify，而不是 quality。

entries.definition: a word or person that limits or qualifies. Another branch of the qual- family.
entries.definitionCN: 限定词；取得资格者。qual- 词族的另一支。

entries.definition: giving an account of what something is like rather than measuring it.
entries.definitionCN: 描述某物是什么样子，而非测量它。

entries.definition: resting on personal feeling or judgement rather than external measurement.
entries.definitionCN: 基于个人感受或判断，而非外部测量。

entries.definition: based on broad impressions rather than exact detail or figures.
entries.definitionCN: 基于整体印象，而非精确细节或数据。

entries.definition: concerned with explaining meaning, as qualitative research does with interviews and texts.
entries.definitionCN: 着力解释意义的，正如定性研究处理访谈与文本那样。

normalIntro.en: These links are real: Latin qualis 'of what kind', qualitas 'quality', and the English family quality, qualify, qualitative.
normalIntro.cn: 这些联想都是真实的：拉丁语 qualis「何种」、qualitas「性质」，以及英语词族 quality、qualify、qualitative。

normal.en: qualitative = quality + -ative: it is the adjective of quality, just as quantitative is the adjective of quantity.
normal.cn: qualitative = quality + -ative：它是 quality 的形容词，正如 quantitative 是 quantity 的形容词。

normal.en: Qualis asks 'of what kind?', which is exactly what qualitative research tries to answer.
normal.cn: qualis 问的是「何种？」，这正是定性研究想回答的问题。

normal.en: One letter cluster separates the twins: qual- asks what kind, quant- asks how much.
normal.cn: 一对孪生词只差一簇字母：qual- 问「何种」，quant- 问「多少」。

normal.en: Cicero made qualitas to translate Greek poiotēs, so the word has a philosopher's fingerprint on it.
normal.cn: 西塞罗造 qualitas 来翻译希腊语 poiotēs，所以这个词上留着哲学家的指纹。

normal.en: A qualitative adjective such as wooden tells you what kind, not how many.
normal.cn: 像 wooden 这样的性质形容词告诉你「何种」，而不是「几个」。

abstract.en: The core is a question, not a measurement: what is it like?
abstract.cn: 核心是一个提问，而不是一次测量：它是什么样子的？

abstract.en: Quality describes the inside of a thing; quantity describes its outside size.
abstract.cn: 性质描述一个东西的内部，数量描述它的外部大小。

abstract.en: Everything qualitative can be said in words but not always put on a scale.
abstract.cn: 定性的东西都能用话讲清楚，却不一定能放上秤。

examples.en: The study combines qualitative interviews with a large survey.
examples.cn: 这项研究把定性访谈与大规模问卷调查结合起来。

examples.en: There is a qualitative difference between solving a puzzle and understanding it.
examples.cn: 解出一道谜题与真正理解它之间存在质的差别。

examples.en: Qualitative analysis identified the metal but did not measure its amount.
examples.cn: 定性分析查明了那种金属，但没有测定它的含量。

dict_mnemonic.text: quality（质量）+ -ative（……的）——不问多少，只问「什么质地」→ qualitative 定性的

root: 源自拉丁语 qualis「何种的」，西塞罗据以造出 qualitas「性质」，中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus「关于性质的」经法语进入英语；核心是「问种类、问质地，而不问数量」。

sensesIntro.en: Nine senses, all variations of one question: what kind is it? The word starts as 'producing a quality', becomes 'about quality rather than quantity', and then serves research methods, chemistry, philosophy, and grammar.
sensesIntro.cn: 九个义项都是同一个提问的变奏：它属于何种？这个词从「产生性质」开始，变成「关于性质而非数量」，随后服务于研究方法、化学、哲学与语法。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: looking at what a thing is like instead of weighing how much of it there is.
core.cn: 核心意象：去看一个东西是什么样子，而不是去称它有多少。

branches.en: METHOD AND DATA: study by description, and words rather than figures.
branches.cn: 方法与数据：以描述做研究，用文字而非数字。

branches.en: PROPERTY AND KIND: what a thing possesses, and differences in kind.
branches.cn: 属性与种类：事物具有的性质，以及种类上的差别。

branches.en: STANDARD AND STATE: improvement in excellence, and change into another state.
branches.cn: 水准与状态：品质上的提升，以及跃入另一种状态的变化。

branches.en: WHAT IS PRESENT: chemical identification without measurement.
branches.cn: 有什么：不作测量的化学鉴定。

branches.en: JUDGEMENT AND GRAMMAR: the feel of a thing, and the adjective that names a quality.
branches.cn: 判断与语法：凭手感下的结论，以及命名性质的形容词。

intro.en: Qualitative is qual- plus -itative. Its family shows the question stem qual- 'what kind', the noun suffix -ity, the verb suffix -ify, and the adjective endings -ed, -ative and -ly.
intro.cn: qualitative 是 qual- 加 -itative。它的词族展示疑问词干 qual-「何种」、名词后缀 -ity、动词后缀 -ify，以及形容词词尾 -ed、-ative 和 -ly。

latinIntro.en: Latin qualis 'of what kind' gives qualitas 'quality', then Medieval Latin qualitativus. The same stem, through qualificare, gives qualify and qualification.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语 qualis「何种」给出 qualitas「性质」，再给出中世纪拉丁语 qualitativus。同一个词干经 qualificare 又给出 qualify 与 qualification。

items.meaningCN: 定性的；性质上的（-ative 形容词后缀）
items.example: They chose a qualitative approach for the interviews.
items.exampleCN: 他们对访谈采用了定性方法。

items.structure: Latin qualitas, from qualis (of what kind)
items.meaning: property, character, or degree of excellence
items.example: The quality of the paper is excellent.
items.exampleCN: 纸张的质量非常好。

items.meaning: to make fit; to limit or modify
items.example: This course qualifies you to teach music.
items.exampleCN: 这门课程使你具备教音乐的资格。

items.meaning: a certificate, condition, or limiting statement
items.meaningCN: 资格；限定条件（-ication 名词后缀）
items.example: She has the qualifications for the post.
items.exampleCN: 她具备担任该职位的资格。

items.meaningCN: 合格的；有资格的（-ed 形容词后缀）
items.example: He is a qualified electrician.
items.exampleCN: 他是一名合格的电工。

items.meaning: one who qualifies, or a word that limits
items.meaningCN: 取得资格者；限定词（-er 后缀）
items.example: Very is a qualifier in very cold.
items.exampleCN: very 在 very cold 中是限定词。

items.meaning: to make unfit or declare ineligible
items.meaningCN: 取消资格（dis- 否定 + qualify）
items.example: The runner was disqualified for a false start.
items.exampleCN: 那名跑者因抢跑被取消资格。

items.meaningCN: 无资格的；彻底的、无保留的（un- 否定）
items.example: She gave the plan unqualified support.
items.exampleCN: 她毫无保留地支持这项计划。

items.meaning: in terms of quality, not amount
items.meaningCN: 定性地；从性质上（-ly 副词后缀）
items.example: The two systems differ qualitatively.
items.exampleCN: 这两个系统在性质上不同。

latinEntries.meaning: of what kind? what sort of?

definition_zh: 包含；涵盖；包围；围绕
definition_en: to surround something, or to include it as part of a larger whole
core_image: 一道圆墙从四面合拢，把散落的房屋、井与树全部圈进墙内
scene: 课程说明列出的主题从语法、阅读一直排到学术写作，几乎没有遗漏。 The course encompasses grammar, reading and academic writing.
sceneCN: 这里指课程把多个主题全部纳入范围（第 3 个义项：涵盖某一学科或主题范围）；句意：这门课程涵盖语法、阅读与学术写作。

pos.zh: 包含；涵盖；包围；围绕

senses.title: To surround on all sides
senses.definition: to encircle a place or an object so that it is enclosed on every side
senses.definitionCN: 把某个地方或物体从四面包起来，使其被围在中间
senses.example: High walls encompass the old courtyard.
senses.exampleCN: 高墙把这座旧庭院四面围住。
senses.why: The word begins with a picture of walking a full circle around something, which is physical enclosure.
senses.whyCN: 这个词最初描绘的是绕某物走满一圈，也就是物理上的围合。

senses.title: To include as parts of a whole
senses.titleCN: 作为整体的一部分包含
senses.definition: to have a number of things inside a larger group or system
senses.definitionCN: 在一个更大的群体或系统内部容纳若干事物
senses.example: The collection encompasses works from three centuries.
senses.exampleCN: 这批藏品包含三个世纪的作品。
senses.why: Once a circle is drawn, everything inside it is included, so enclosure becomes inclusion.
senses.whyCN: 圆圈一旦画定，圈内的一切便都被纳入，围合由此变成包含。

senses.title: To cover a subject or field
senses.definition: of a course, a book or a survey, to deal with a whole field of material
senses.definitionCN: 指课程、书籍或综述处理整片材料领域
senses.example: The course encompasses grammar, reading and academic writing.
senses.exampleCN: 这门课程涵盖语法、阅读与学术写作。
senses.why: A syllabus is a boundary, and whatever falls inside its line is what the course covers.
senses.whyCN: 教学大纲就是一条边界，落在界线之内的一切就是课程涵盖的内容。

senses.title: To contain the members of a category
senses.definition: in logic, of a class or a term, to have certain members within its scope
senses.definitionCN: 在逻辑中，指某个类别或术语把某些成员纳入其范围
senses.example: The category encompasses both birds and bats.
senses.exampleCN: 这个类别既包括鸟类，也包括蝙蝠。
senses.why: A category is a circle in logic diagrams, and what it encompasses is what lies inside the circle.
senses.whyCN: 在逻辑图里类别就是一个圆，它所包含的就是圆内的东西。

senses.title: To enclose a piece of land
senses.definition: of a fence, a wall or a boundary, to shut in a piece of land
senses.definitionCN: 指篱笆、围墙或边界把一片土地围起来
senses.example: The new park encompasses the old orchard and the pond.
senses.exampleCN: 新公园把旧果园与池塘都圈了进去。
senses.why: Land is the most literal object of the verb, since a boundary drawn on the ground can be walked.
senses.whyCN: 土地是这个动词最字面的宾语，因为画在地上的界线可以真的走一圈。

senses.title: Of a policy that embraces goals
senses.definition: of a plan or a policy, to take in several aims or values as one programme
senses.definitionCN: 指计划或政策把若干目标或价值纳入同一套方案
senses.example: The reform encompasses both housing and transport.
senses.exampleCN: 这项改革把住房与交通都纳入其中。
senses.why: A policy, like a wall, draws a line around what it will deal with, and that line is its scope.
senses.whyCN: 政策像围墙一样，为它要处理的事画出界线，这条界线就是它的范围。

senses.title: To go around something (old sense)
senses.definition: in older usage, to travel all the way around a place
senses.definitionCN: 在较早用法中，指绕某地走完一整圈
senses.example: The old text describes a pilgrim who encompassed the shrine.
senses.exampleCN: 那篇旧文描述一位绕行圣殿一周的朝圣者。
senses.why: The oldest sense is the walk itself, before the word became a matter of scope.
senses.whyCN: 最早的义项就是走这一圈本身，后来这个词才转向范围问题。

senses.title: To cover every case or possibility
senses.definition: to take in all relevant cases so that none is left outside
senses.definitionCN: 把所有相关情形都纳入，不留下任何一个在外面
senses.example: The rules are written to encompass every likely dispute.
senses.exampleCN: 这些规则的写法要涵盖所有可能出现的纠纷。
senses.why: Completeness is a circle with no gap in it, which is why the word can mean covering everything.
senses.whyCN: 完整就是一个没有缺口的圆，因此这个词可以表示涵盖一切。

intro.en: Encompass is an English verb built from a prefix meaning in and a noun for a circuit or a circle. The noun came from Latin by way of French, and the verb has meant both to surround and to include since the fourteenth century.
intro.cn: 本词是英语动词，由表示「进入」的前缀与表示一周、一圈的名词构成。那个名词经法语来自拉丁语，这个动词自十四世纪起就兼指环绕与包含。

items.en: Passus meant a step, and it stands behind English words for pace and for the measured stride.
items.cn: 这个拉丁名词指一步，英语中表示步幅与步测的词都出自它。

items.en: The verb meant to measure out by steps, and so to go around a space with a measured stride.
items.cn: 这个拉丁动词意为用步子量出，因此指以等长的步幅绕一片空间走一圈。

items.en: Old French took the word for a circuit, a circle and the instrument that draws one.
items.cn: 古法语用这个词指一周、一圈，也指画圆的器具。

items.en: English borrowed the noun as a circuit or a boundary, and kept the tool sense for the magnetic compass.
items.cn: 英语借入这个名词，指一周或一条边界，并保留了指磁性罗盘的工具义。

items.en: The verb, recorded from the fourteenth century, first meant to go around and then to shut in.
items.cn: 这个动词自十四世纪有记载，先指绕行，后指围在里面。

items.en: Modern usage made inclusion the dominant sense, so a course or a policy encompasses its material.
items.cn: 现代用法让「包含」成为主导义，因此课程或政策会把其内容涵盖在内。

note.en: The first group shares the circuit noun or looks close to it; the second group names nearby kinds of inclusion and enclosure. Encompass stresses that everything lies inside one boundary, while include only says that something is among the parts.
note.cn: 第一组共享表示一圈的名词或字形相近；第二组是相邻的包含与围合类型。本词强调一切都在同一条界线之内，包含类词只说某物在组成部分之中。

entries.definition: an instrument for finding direction, or a range
entries.definitionCN: 罗盘；范围

entries.definition: a way through or a section of text
entries.definitionCN: 通道；段落

entries.definition: a single step or the speed of walking
entries.definitionCN: 一步；步速

entries.definition: to contain as part of a whole
entries.definitionCN: 包括；包含

entries.definition: to consist of or be made up of
entries.definitionCN: 由…组成；包含

entries.definition: to extend over or deal with
entries.definitionCN: 覆盖；涉及

entries.definition: to include willingly or hold closely
entries.definitionCN: 包含；拥抱

entries.definition: to be all around something
entries.definitionCN: 包围；环绕

entries.definition: to hold within limits
entries.definitionCN: 容纳；包含

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the circuit noun, the real family and the phrases of courses and policies.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用表示一圈的名词、真实同族词，以及课程与政策方面的固定搭配。

normal.en: The noun inside means a circuit, so the verb is to draw that circuit around something.
normal.cn: 里面的名词意为一周，动词就是围绕某物画出这一周。

normal.en: The family runs compass, encompassment, encompassing and the rare compassable.
normal.cn: 同族词有罗盘、涵盖、涵盖广泛的，以及罕见的可围绕的。

normal.en: Fixed phrases mark it: encompass a range, encompass all aspects, be encompassed by.
normal.cn: 固定搭配标出用法：涵盖一个范围、涵盖各方面、被某物包围。

normal.en: The land sense is literal: a park that takes in an old orchard and a pond.
normal.cn: 土地义最字面：一座把旧果园与池塘圈进来的公园。

normal.en: The syllabus is a drawn line, and what falls inside it is what the course covers.
normal.cn: 教学大纲就是画出的界线，落在界内就是课程涵盖的内容。

abstract.en: Picture a rope laid on the ground in a single closed circle.
abstract.cn: 想象一根绳在地上摆成一个闭合的圆。

abstract.en: Picture a sentence that can hold every example you can think of inside its grammar.
abstract.cn: 想象一句话，它的语法装得下你能想到的所有例子。

abstract.en: Picture a net thrown over a whole orchard, branches and fruit together.
abstract.cn: 想象一张网罩住整片果园，枝与果一并罩住。

examples.en: The reserve encompasses three lakes and a stretch of forest.
examples.cn: 保护区包含三个湖泊和一片森林。

examples.en: Her report encompasses both the causes and the remedies.
examples.cn: 她的报告既涵盖原因，也涵盖补救办法。

examples.en: The old walls encompass the entire village.
examples.cn: 旧城墙把整个村庄围在里面。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「恩」加「康帕斯」——拿圆规在地上画一整圈，把东西全圈进来：包含、包围

root: 拉丁语「步」衍生出「用步子量一圈」的动词，经古法语指一周、一圈及画圆之器，十四世纪进入英语；由环绕转指包含。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one circle: physical enclosure, inclusion in a whole, a field covered, a category's members, a walled piece of land, a policy's aims, an old walk around and completeness.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿着同一个圆：物理围合、作为整体的一部分、被涵盖的领域、类别的成员、圈起的土地、政策的目标、古义的绕行与完整无缺。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: a round wall closing from every side, taking in the scattered houses, the well and the trees.
core.cn: 核心意象：一道圆墙从四面合拢，把散落的房屋、井与树全部圈进墙内。

branches.en: THE PHYSICAL RING: a place surrounded, and a park walled around an orchard and a pond.
branches.cn: 物理圆环：被围住的地方，以及把果园与池塘圈进墙内的公园。

branches.en: THE MEMBERS: works inside a collection, and members inside a logical category.
branches.cn: 成员：藏品中的作品，以及逻辑类别中的成员。

branches.en: THE SCOPE: a course covering a field, and a policy taking in several aims.
branches.cn: 范围：涵盖某一领域的课程，以及纳入多项目标的政策。

branches.en: THE OLD WALK: a pilgrim travelling all the way around a shrine.
branches.cn: 古义的绕行：朝圣者绕圣殿走完一整圈。

branches.en: THE COMPLETE CIRCLE: every case taken in, with no gap left in the line.
branches.cn: 完整之圆：所有情形都被纳入，界线没有缺口。

intro.en: Encompass is an English verb built on a noun that Latin gave to French and French to English; its family supplies the tool, the range and the rare nominal forms.
intro.cn: 本词是英语动词，其基础名词由拉丁语传给法语、再传给英语；词族提供工具、范围与罕见的名称形式。

latinIntro.en: Latin passus and the verb for measuring by steps supply the core; English added the in-prefix and the verb shape.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁语中表示一步的词与表示用步子量测的动词提供核心，英语加上表示进入的前缀与动词外形。

items.example: It puts the object inside the drawn circle.
items.exampleCN: 它把宾语放进画好的圆内。

items.example: The root supplies the measured stride.
items.exampleCN: 词根提供量步的动作。

items.example: The verb supplies the walking of a full circuit.
items.exampleCN: 这个动词提供走满一圈的动作。

items.meaning: a circuit; a circle; the tool
items.example: French passed the noun to English.
items.exampleCN: 法语把这个名词传给英语。

items.example: The noun survives in the modern range sense.
items.exampleCN: 这个名词以现代范围义留存下来。

items.example: It builds the rare noun for the state of inclusion.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示被纳入状态的罕见名词。

items.example: It builds the participle and the adjective.
items.exampleCN: 它构成分词与形容词。

items.example: It marks what has already been enclosed.
items.exampleCN: 它标记已被围入之物。

items.example: It builds the rare adjective for what can be surrounded.
items.exampleCN: 它构成表示可被围绕的罕见形容词。

latinEntries.meaning: to measure out by steps, to go around

同根远亲词，义为「一步、步速」

definition_zh: 沉积物；沉淀物；泥沙；沉淀（动词）
definition_en: solid material that settles at the bottom of a liquid, or that is carried and laid down by water, wind or ice
core_image: 浑浊的河水在入海口慢下来，细沙一粒粒沉到瓶底，清水留在上层
scene: 河水灌进玻璃瓶，静置到第二天早晨，细泥沉到瓶底，上层的液体变清了。 Fine sediment settled to the bottom of the jar by morning.
sceneCN: 这里 sediment 指「液体中沉降到底部的固体颗粒」（第 1 个义项：沉积下来的泥沙等固体物质）；句意为细小的沉积物在夜里沉到瓶底。可辨识物件：玻璃瓶、浑浊河水、瓶底细泥、上层清水。

pos.zh: 沉积物；沉淀物；泥沙
使沉积；沉淀（技术用法）

senses.title: Material laid down by water, wind or ice
senses.titleCN: 由水、风或冰堆积下来的物质
senses.definition: solid particles carried by water, wind or ice and left behind when the carrier loses energy
senses.definitionCN: 指被水、风或冰搬运、在搬运介质失去能量后留下的固体颗粒
senses.example: Fine sediment settled to the bottom of the jar by morning.
senses.exampleCN: 细小的沉积物在夜里沉到了瓶底。
senses.why: Sedere 'to sit' plus -mentum 'result' gives 'what has sat down'; the word names the material only after it has stopped moving.
senses.whyCN: sedere「坐」加 -mentum「结果」给出「已经坐下来的东西」；这个词只在那物质停止移动之后才命名它。

senses.title: Solids that settle in a liquid
senses.titleCN: 液体中沉到底部的固体
senses.definition: the solid matter that sinks to the bottom of a standing liquid
senses.definitionCN: 指在静置液体中下沉到底部的固体物质
senses.example: A dark sediment gathered at the bottom of the kettle.
senses.exampleCN: 水壶底部积起一层深色沉淀。
senses.why: It is the same settling seen in a kitchen: any liquid left standing leaves its solids behind.
senses.whyCN: 这是厨房里也能见到的同一种沉降：任何静置的液体都会把固体留在底部。

senses.title: A deposited layer or stratum
senses.titleCN: 沉积形成的一层或一层岩层
senses.definition: a single bed or layer of deposited material, often visible as a band
senses.definitionCN: 指沉积形成的一层材料，常呈带状可见
senses.example: Each sediment band records a different flood.
senses.exampleCN: 每一层沉积都记录了一次不同的洪水。
senses.why: Once the deposit is thick enough to see, it becomes a layer, and the noun moves from material to a visible band.
senses.whyCN: 一旦沉积厚到肉眼可见，它就成了一层，名词也从材料转向可见的层带。

senses.title: Suspended load in moving water
senses.definition: particles held in suspension in a river or current, measured as water quality
senses.definitionCN: 指河流或水流中悬而未落的颗粒，作为水质指标测定
senses.example: The dam traps sediment that once reached the delta.
senses.exampleCN: 大坝拦住了原本到达三角洲的悬移质。
senses.why: Particles that have not yet settled are still sediment, so the word follows the material through its whole journey.
senses.whyCN: 尚未落下的颗粒仍然是 sediment，因此这个词跟着物质走完整个搬运过程。

senses.title: Lees at the bottom of wine or vinegar
senses.definition: the deposit of dead yeast and particles found in wine, cider or vinegar
senses.definitionCN: 指葡萄酒、苹果酒或醋中死酵母与颗粒形成的沉渣
senses.example: Pour the wine slowly so the sediment stays in the bottle.
senses.exampleCN: 慢慢倒酒，让沉渣留在瓶里。
senses.why: Wine lees are the household version of the geological process, so the same noun serves both.
senses.whyCN: 酒渣是这一地质过程在厨房里的版本，因此同一个名词两边都用。

senses.title: Accumulated remains of the past
senses.titleCN: 比喻：历史或记忆的层层积存
senses.definition: figurative: the accumulated, slowly deposited remains of an earlier period
senses.definitionCN: 比喻用法：较早时期缓慢积存下来的遗留物
senses.example: Old letters lay in the sediment of family memory.
senses.exampleCN: 旧信件沉在家族记忆的底层。
senses.why: The metaphor works because memory also deposits slowly and in layers, with older things lower down.
senses.whyCN: 这个比喻成立，是因为记忆也缓慢、分层地沉积，越老的东西越靠下。

senses.title: To deposit as sediment (technical verb)
senses.definition: to cause particles to settle out of a liquid, or to deposit them
senses.definitionCN: 指使颗粒从液体中沉降出来，或把它们沉积下来
senses.example: The current sediments sand along the inner bend.
senses.exampleCN: 水流把砂沉积在内侧河弯。
senses.why: English verbs form freely from nouns, and technical writing needs a verb for the act of depositing.
senses.whyCN: 英语动词可由名词自由构成，而技术写作需要一个动词来表达「使沉积」这一动作。

senses.title: The geological archive of a basin
senses.definition: the whole body of deposits in a basin, read as a record of past environments
senses.definitionCN: 指盆地中全部沉积体，被当作过去环境的记录来解读
senses.example: The sediment of the lake bed spans ten thousand years.
senses.exampleCN: 湖底的沉积层跨越了一万年。
senses.why: A basin's whole fill is read as a record, so the mass noun becomes a collective archive.
senses.whyCN: 盆地的全部充填物被当作记录来读，于是这个物质名词变成了集体档案。

intro.en: Sediment comes from the Latin noun for a settling, built on the verb 'to sit'. The geological sense is a later specialization of a very general image.
intro.cn: sediment 来自拉丁语表示「沉降」的名词，由动词「坐、停留」构成；地质义是这个极普遍意象后来的专门化。

items.en: Sedere 'to sit, stay, settle' is a second-conjugation verb with the stem sed-, and it underlies a large family: session, resident, sedentary, sedative.
items.cn: sedere「坐、停留、安定」是第二变格法动词，词干 sed-，支撑起一个大家族：session、resident、sedentary、sedative。

items.en: Sedimentum 'a settling, a sinking down, dregs' was formed with -mentum, the suffix for the result of an action, so the noun names what has settled rather than the settling itself.
items.cn: sedimentum「沉降、沉下、渣滓」由 -mentum 构成，这个后缀表示动作的结果，因此名词命名的是「沉下来的东西」，而不是「下沉」这一动作。

items.en: English took the word through French sédiment in the sixteenth century, first for dregs and earthy matter in liquids.
items.cn: 英语在十六世纪经法语 sédiment 借入这个词，最初指液体中的渣滓与土质物。

items.en: From the eighteenth century sediment was applied to sand, mud and gravel laid down by water, and the noun became central to stratigraphy.
items.cn: 从十八世纪起，sediment 被用于水所堆积的砂、泥与砾石，这个名词成为地层学的核心。

items.en: The verb sedimented appears later, chiefly in technical writing, where it means to settle out or to deposit particles.
items.cn: 动词 sedimented 出现较晚，主要用于技术写作，意为沉降析出或使颗粒沉积。

items.en: Not uncertain: the derivation from sedere is established. What is reconstructed is the Indo-European root *sed- 'sit', which is inferred from Sanskrit and Greek cognates rather than attested directly.
items.cn: 并非存疑：源自 sedere 这一点是确定的。属重构的是印欧词根 *sed-「坐」，它由梵语与希腊语同族词推断而来，而非直接实证。

note.en: Group one holds words that look like sediment but come from other roots; group two holds materials and processes often named beside it.
note.cn: 第一组是外形近似但词根不同的词；第二组是常与它并称的材料与过程词。

entries.definition: Means a feeling or opinion, from Latin sentire 'to feel'; the shared letters sed- are accidental, since the root here is sent-.
entries.definitionCN: 意为情感或看法，来自拉丁 sentire「感觉」；共同的字母只是巧合，这里的词根是 sent-。

entries.definition: A calming drug, from sedare 'to settle, calm', a causative form of sedere; it shares the root 'sit' but means 'making something settle down'.
entries.definitionCN: 指镇静药，来自 sedare「使安定」，是 sedere 的使动形式；它共享「坐」的词根，但意思是「使某物安定下来」。

entries.definition: Means sitting much or fixed in one place, from sedere plus -ary; it is a true relative and describes the posture, not the deposit.
entries.definitionCN: 意为久坐的、固定一处的，来自 sedere 加 -ary；它是真正的同族词，描写姿势而非沉积物。

entries.definition: A meeting or sitting of a body, from sedere through Latin sessio; related in root, unrelated in meaning.
entries.definitionCN: 指机构的一次会议或开庭，经拉丁 sessio 来自 sedere；词根相关，意义无关。

entries.definition: Any material left by a natural process, or the act of laying it down; it is the wider word that sediment belongs to.
entries.definitionCN: 指任何自然过程留下的物质或堆积动作；它是 sediment 所属的更宽泛的词。

entries.definition: Specifically sediment of grains between sand and clay in size; it is one size class of sediment, not a synonym.
entries.definitionCN: 特指粒径介于砂与黏土之间的细粒沉积物；它只是沉积物的一个粒级，不是同义词。

entries.definition: Thick wet waste from sewage or industry; it stresses pollution and disposal, while sediment is neutral.
entries.definitionCN: 指污水或工业产生的黏稠湿废物；它强调污染与处置，sediment 则是中性词。

entries.definition: Solid matter thrown out of a solution by a chemical reaction, not by simple settling; chemistry keeps the two apart.
entries.definitionCN: 指化学反应从溶液中析出的固体，而非单纯沉降；化学上二者区分明确。

normalIntro.en: Normal associations use the real Latin verb, the real suffix and the real geological phrases.
normalIntro.cn: 正常联想使用真实的拉丁动词、真实的后缀与真实的地质搭配。

normal.en: Sedere 'to sit' plus -mentum 'result': the stuff that has sat down at the bottom.
normal.cn: sedere「坐」加 -mentum「结果」：已经坐到底部的东西。

normal.en: The family runs sediment, sedimentary, sedimentation, sedimentology.
normal.cn: 同族词包括 sediment、sedimentary、sedimentation、sedimentology。

normal.en: Fixed phrases: fine sediment, suspended sediment, sediment core, sediment transport.
normal.cn: 固定搭配：细沉积物、悬浮沉积物、沉积柱样、沉积物搬运。

normal.en: The same root gives session, resident and sedentary, all about sitting or staying.
normal.cn: 同一词根衍生 session、resident、sedentary，都与坐或停留有关。

normal.en: In a river the sediment travels high in flood and rests low in drought.
normal.cn: 在河里，沉积物洪水时高悬、枯水时落底。

abstract.en: Picture a clock that records time by dropping sand instead of moving hands.
abstract.cn: 想象一座靠落沙而非指针记录时间的钟。

abstract.en: Picture a library where every reader leaves one grain on the floor.
abstract.cn: 想象一座图书馆，每位读者都在地板上留下一粒沙。

abstract.en: Picture a river writing its diary in mud at the bottom of a lake.
abstract.cn: 想象一条河在湖底用泥写下自己的日记。

examples.en: The reservoir is filling with sediment faster than expected.
examples.cn: 水库正以超出预期的速度被泥沙填满。

examples.en: A core of lake sediment shows layers of ash from old eruptions.
examples.cn: 一根湖底沉积柱样显示出古老喷发留下的层层火山灰。

examples.en: Let the vinegar stand until the sediment sinks.
examples.cn: 让醋静置到沉渣落下。

dict_mnemonic.text: 「塞（se）底（di）闷（ment）」——塞在底下的东西 → 沉积物、沉淀

root: 拉丁 sedere「坐、停留」+ -mentum（动作结果）→ sedimentum「沉降、沉渣」；英语经法语 sédiment 借入。印欧词根 *sed-「坐」属重构形式。

sensesIntro.en: Eight senses follow one motion: particles lose their energy and sit down, and that single settling then becomes a layer, a load, a wine lees, a family memory, a verb and finally a whole archive.
sensesIntro.cn: 八个义项沿同一个动作展开：颗粒失去能量而落下，这一次沉降随后变成一层、一份载荷、一份酒渣、一段家族记忆、一个动词，最后成为一整部档案。

core.en: CORE IMAGE: grains falling through still water and coming to rest on the bottom.
core.cn: 核心意象：颗粒穿过静水落下，停在底部。

branches.en: SETTLING: the physical act is the same in a river, a kettle and a jar.
branches.cn: 沉降：河、壶、瓶中的物理动作相同。

branches.en: LAYER UPON LAYER: one band is an event, and the whole stack is an archive.
branches.cn: 层层相叠：一层是一次事件，整叠则是一部档案。

branches.en: ON THE MOVE: before it settles, the same material is a suspended load and a water-quality problem.
branches.cn: 搬运之中：在沉降之前，同样的物质是悬移质，也是水质问题。

branches.en: IN A BOTTLE: wine lees are the same settling seen in a kitchen.
branches.cn: 瓶中：酒渣是同一沉降在厨房里的样子。

branches.en: FROM NOUN TO VERB AND TO MEMORY: what settles can be laid down deliberately, or remembered slowly.
branches.cn: 从名词到动词与记忆：沉下的东西可以被有意堆积，也可以被缓慢记住。

intro.en: Sediment is built from a Latin verb plus a result suffix, and both pieces recur across a large English family.
intro.cn: sediment 由拉丁动词加结果后缀构成，这两部分在英语的大家族中反复出现。

latinIntro.en: Latin sedere 'to sit' gives sediment, session, resident, sedentary and sedative; -mentum marks the result of an action, as in monumentum and argumentum.
latinIntro.cn: 拉丁 sedere「坐」衍生 sediment、session、resident、sedentary 与 sedative；-mentum 标记动作结果，如 monumentum 与 argumentum。

items.structure: sedere (Latin verb, second conjugation, stem sed-)
items.example: The root describes coming to rest.
items.exampleCN: 这个词根描写归于静止。

items.example: The suffix turns the act of settling into the thing settled.
items.exampleCN: 这个后缀把「沉降」这一动作变成沉下来的东西。

items.example: Fine sediment settled in the jar.
items.exampleCN: 细沉积物沉在瓶底。

items.example: The cliff is made of sedimentary rock.
items.exampleCN: 这处崖壁由沉积岩构成。

items.example: Sedimentation filled the old channel.
items.exampleCN: 沉积作用填满了旧河道。

items.example: Sedimentology explains the ripple marks.
items.exampleCN: 沉积学解释了这些波痕。

items.example: A sedimentological study followed the core.
items.exampleCN: 一项沉积学研究跟进了这根柱样。

items.example: The sedimentologist dated the layers.
items.exampleCN: 沉积学家测定了各层的年代。

items.example: The council held a long session.
items.exampleCN: 议会开了长时间的一次会议。
